High M-shaped hairline with deep temporal recession and short dark wavy hair styled away from the forehead characterize this adult with a clean-shaven face and light stubble on the upper lip. The subject has an oblong face with a prominent bone structure, a high and broad forehead, and prominent brow ridges with minimal spacing. Features include medium-thick soft-arched eyebrows with downward sloping lateral tails, almond-shaped eyes with moderate upper-lid creases, and a straight nasal bridge with a slightly bulbous tip. The jawline is strong and continuous with a rounded chin showing a slight central indentation, while moderate-sized free-lobed ears are positioned level with the eye-nose line.
